infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: KidsConnect uses the camera so you can record a short video message for a friend.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: KidsConnect uses the microphone to record sound in your video message.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow KidsConnect to use the camera to record video messages.
plugins.microphonePermission: Allow KidsConnect to use the microphone to record video messages.
